What are the IATA Live Animals Regulations?
The global standard for carrying animals by air. They set container sizes and designs, feeding and watering, labelling and handling for each kind of animal.
Which Indian authority clears animal imports?
Animal Quarantine and Certification Services (AQCS) handles quarantine inspection and clearance, alongside Customs.
An international agreement that controls trade in endangered species. Protected animals need CITES permits from both the exporting and importing countries.
